test_PPO_simple_game: test the PPO agent training loop on a simple two-action EFG game with annealed learning rate
create_PPO_agent: create a PPO agent with input shape, number of actions, players, and environment count for reinforcement learning
build_sync_vector_env: build a SyncVectorEnv wrapper around rl_environment.Environment for batched game step execution
run_PPO_training: run PPO training with agent.step, envs.step, agent.post_step, anneal_learning_rate, and agent.learn in a loop
test_PPO_evaluation: test PPO evaluation by running agent.step with is_evaluation=True and accumulating total reward over multiple episodes
